# oriz-md — Markdown Studio

> Free, 100% client-side split-screen editor for GitHub-Flavored Markdown. Live preview, syntax highlighting, auto table of contents, HTML/Markdown export, print-to-PDF, and optional AI assist. No upload, no signup, no tracking — everything runs in your browser. Live at https://md.oriz.in

## Core

- [Live app](https://md.oriz.in): The Markdown studio — write GFM on the left, see the rendered preview on the right, in real time.
- [About / info page](https://chirag127.github.io/oriz-md/): What oriz-md is, its features, and its tech stack.
- [Source code](https://github.com/chirag127/oriz-md): MIT-licensed Astro + React source on GitHub.

## Features

- Live GFM preview: headings, tables, task lists, autolinks, strikethrough — rendered as you type via `marked`, sanitized with DOMPurify.
- Syntax highlighting: highlight.js, lazy-loaded only when a document contains code fences.
- Auto table of contents: generated from headings with in-page anchor links.
- Export: download a standalone `.html` or `.md` file, or print to PDF through the browser print dialog.
- Focus mode: dims everything except the current writing area.
- AI assist (optional): expand an outline, summarize, fix markdown, or generate a TOC — via free g4f providers with failover; if AI is down the document is untouched.
- Autosave: the document persists to `localStorage` between sessions.
- Drag & drop: drop a `.md` file onto the editor to open it.
- PWA: installable, works offline after first load.

## Tech

- Client-only Astro static site with a React 19 island for the editor.
- Tailwind v4 styling; shared `@chirag127/oz-*` packages (oz-ai, oz-file, oz-tokens-base, oz-chrome) for mechanism.
- AI via g4f (`@chirag127/oz-ai`) — keyless, multi-provider, browser-side.
- 100% in-browser: no server, no upload, no signup, no tracking.
